jobDescription:
ABOUT UA/UNIFORM ADVANTAGE BRANDS

For over 40 years, UA Brands has designed fashion-forward apparel for the medical and culinary professionals who make a difference every day. We re proud to support the people behind the work, those showing up and making an impact every shift. We re a purpose-driven team with a strong commitment to community, collaboration, and service. Here, you ll find a culture that values connection, fresh perspectives, and real impact. From the start, we re committed to giving you an authentic look at life at UA Brands and how you can grow, contribute, and make your mark.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This role follows a permanent work schedule of 6:00 PM to 3:00 AM IST, Monday through Friday.

We are looking for an applied AI and automation engineer to build and ship practical tools that make UA s operations faster and more reliable. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role: the person takes problems and priorities defined by leadership and turns them into working software AI agents, automations, scripts, and integrations that connect our systems and remove manual work. Success is measured by what ships and the results it produces, not by research or strategy. A core part of the job is technical judgment: knowing when a problem genuinely needs AI versus when a simpler, reliable rule-based tool is the right answer, and building accordingly.

Initial work centers on UA s AI and automation roadmap: building and deploying managed AI agents for operations use cases such as order and return exception handling and inbound document processing, automating manual B2B and customer-service workflows, and integrating these solutions with existing systems including Dynamics AX, Zoom Contact Center, and Microsoft 365. The role works under the direction of the Project Manager and partners with IT, operations, and outside vendors to scope and deliver.

WHAT YOU LL DO

  • Build, test, and deploy AI agents and automations for prioritized operations use cases (e.g., order and return exception handling; inbound document processing against Dynamics AX).
  • Build deterministic automation tools and scripts where business logic is rule-based (e.g., conditional product removal, dormant account review), reserving AI for inputs that are genuinely unstructured.
  • Collaborate with IT, operations, and outside vendors to scope, validate, and prioritize automation opportunities.
  • Document builds, configurations, and runbooks, and support handoff to operations and other teams.
  • Evaluate vendor and platform AI capabilities to inform build-versus-buy decisions and avoid duplicating features already on a vendor roadmap.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between AI/automation solutions and existing systems (Dynamics AX 2012 R3 via SFTP, Zoom Contact Center, Microsoft 365).
  • Automate manual operations and workflows (e.g., Pardot form and order entry, alerting and escalation routing).
  • Test, monitor, and report on the accuracy, performance, and ROI of deployed AI and automation solutions; flag and resolve failures.
  • Maintain, debug, and improve tools already running in production.
  • Translate leadership objectives and business requirements into technical specifications and working prototypes.

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Advanced proficiency in Python (or an equivalent programming language) for developing automations, scripts, and system integrations.
  • Sound judgment to determine when a problem is best addressed using AI versus deterministic or rule-based solutions.
  • Strong experience in debugging, testing, deploying, and monitoring production-grade solutions.
  • Proficiency in API and data integration, including file-based exchanges, SFTP, and integrations with legacy applications and ERP systems.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered solutions using LLM APIs and agent frameworks, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and tool/function calling.
  • Highly self-directed, with the ability to consistently deliver high-quality outcomes with minimal supervision.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and structured data management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, solution designs, and functional prototypes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor s degree or equivalent demonstrated experience with a Specialization or Major in Computer Science or Data Science or Computer Engineering or equivalent stream.

TYPE OF EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

More than 2 years of hands-on experience in:

  • Designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered or automation solutions in production environments (beyond academic projects, prototypes, or demonstrations).
  • Integrating systems and data through APIs, SFTP/file-based exchanges, and legacy or ERP platforms.
  • Building and implementing solutions using LLM APIs and agent frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications:

Candidates with hands-on experience using LLM APIs and agent frameworks (such as LangChain or LangGraph), along with experience integrating AI solutions with ERP and legacy enterprise systems, will be given preference.

WHERE YOU LL WORK - PERMANENT WORK FROM HOME (India)

This is a permanent remote role based in India, allowing you to work exclusively from your home within India, with no daily commute.

Remote employees are expected to be available and actively working during their teams designated core business hours to ensure effective collaboration. The company will provide all required computer equipment for business use.

This role may require occasional business travel to our U.S. headquarters, located in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Situated in one of the countrys most scenic coastal destinations, Fort Lauderdale is known for its beautiful beaches, vibrant waterfront, and year-round warm climate. Candidates who already hold a valid U.S. Business Visa (B1/B2) will have an advantage.

WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS

Candidates must have a dedicated, quiet, and distraction-free home workspace that supports productive work throughout their scheduled shift, with no conflicting personal or professional responsibilities.

The workspace must also include:

  • A reliable high-speed internet connection with a minimum speed of 100 Mbps.
  • A minimum of 9 hours of uninterrupted power backup to ensure business continuity during working hours.

WHY YOU LL LOVE WORKING HERE

UA BRANDS offers a full range of benefits that address both your health and financial needs.

  • Company-sponsored medical insurance for employees and immediate family members - A family floater of 04 Lakhs.
  • Company-sponsored Group Life insurance for employee - Two times of Cost to Company.
  • Company-sponsored Group Personal Accidental insurance for employee - Two and Half times of Cost to Company.
  • Company-sponsored Gratuity Benefit.
  • Continuous remote work
  • Hardship Allowance: Paid over and above the employees monthly salary.
  • Internet Allowance: Paid over and above the employees monthly salary.
  • Extended Hardship Allowance: Paid over and above the employees monthly salary
  • Paid Vacation / Earned Leave
  • Maternity Leave, Compensatory Off Leave, Bereavement Leave, and Paternity Leave as per the applicable norms.
  • Holiday Pay
  • Referral Program - Get paid to work with Friends
  • Regular Recognition, Social Activities, Monthly Events, and Birthday Celebrations Mandatory Fun.

UA IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

As an employee of any UA Brands division, you will be part of an established and dynamic organization. We believe that success starts from within, and we are seeking individuals who thrive in an environment that encourages and supports self-management. To provide equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals, employment decisions at UA Brands will be based on merit, qualifications, and abilities. UA Brands does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. UA Brands will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship.

Executive Support | Office of the Managing Director | Pune-PCMC Reports to: Managing Director (exclusively) | Works closely with: COO, Head-BD, VP-BD, Finance, Legal |


THE ROLE
The Personal Assistant / Personal Secretary to the Managing Director at ICON Turnkey Ventures LLP is one of the most trusted positions in the organisation. The MD is the face of ICON to clients, banks, government bodies, industry associations, and strategic partners and is simultaneously driving the company from 20-25 Crore toward 100 Crore+ by FY 2028-29. The PA/PS is the person who ensures none of that falls through the cracks.

This role exists to multiply the MD's effectiveness by protecting their time, managing their information flow, coordinating their commitments, and ensuring that every interaction the MD has is well-prepared, well-documented, and well- followed up. The MD should never walk into a meeting unprepared, miss a deadline, or waste time on tasks that can be owned by this role.
The standard for this role in one line: The MD's calendar, correspondence, commitments, and priorities are managed so completely and proactively that the MD's first question in the morning is never 'what do I have today?' because the answer is already on their desk, their phone, and their mind before they ask.


Zero
Missed Deadlines or Appointments


24 Hrs
Correspondence


Turnaround
100%

Confidentiality Standard


MD+1
One Step Ahead At All Times

Completed in Advance


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES & ROLES
1. Calendar & Schedule Management
Own the MD's calendar completely schedule, reschedule, and protect meetings with clients, banks, government bodies, partners, and internal stakeholders. The MD's time is ICON's most valuable resource; this role is the gatekeeper.
Maintain a daily briefing sheet for the MD prepared before 8:30 AM every working day listing the day's meetings (with names, context, and objectives), key deadlines, pending decisions awaiting the MD, and any correspondence requiring the MD's attention.
Anticipate scheduling conflicts and resolve them proactively before the MD is asked. A scheduling clash that reaches the MD is a failure of this role.
Plan and coordinate the MD's travel client visits across Pune-PCMC belt, Mumbai-MMR, and outstation booking transport, accommodation, and meeting logistics in advance. Prepare a travel itinerary document for every outstation trip.
Manage recurring commitments weekly pipeline reviews, monthly bank meetings, quarterly board reviews, and industry association events ensuring these are diarised, reminders set, and preparation materials ready in advance.
2. Correspondence & Communication Management
Screen, prioritise, and manage the MD's email inbox and physical correspondence categorising by urgency and importance, drafting responses for MD review, and routing non-MD items to the COO, BD team, or relevant function.
Draft professional correspondence on behalf of the MD letters to clients, banks, government authorities, legal firms, and industry bodies in precise, formal English and Marathi as required. Every outgoing letter reflects ICON's professional standard.


Prepare MOM (Minutes of Meeting) for all meetings attended by the MD issued within 24 hours of the meeting to all relevant parties, with action items, owners, and deadlines clearly listed.
Follow up on action items from MD meetings tracking who owes what by when, chasing overdue items, and presenting a weekly action tracker to the MD every Monday morning.
Manage the MD's WhatsApp and phone communication support where requested, filter, summarise, and draft responses for high-volume communication during busy periods (board reviews, major bid submissions, banking meetings).
3. Meeting Preparation & Coordination
Prepare a briefing document before every significant MD meeting client background, meeting objective, key discussion points, relevant project history, and any open commercial or relationship items. The MD should never need to ask 'who is this person?' before a meeting.
Arrange all meeting logistics conference room booking, AV setup, tea/coffee/refreshments, printed materials, and visitor reception. Every meeting at ICON's office must run without a logistical failure.
Coordinate pre-meeting inputs from the COO, Head-BD, or Project Managers when the meeting requires technical or commercial context ensuring all information reaches the MD at least 1 hour before the meeting.
Prepare presentation materials, data summaries, and briefing packs for the MD's external presentations board meetings, bank presentations, client capability presentations, and industry forums in coordination with the relevant function head.
4. Document Management & Filing
Maintain a structured document management system for the MD's office contracts, board resolutions, banking documents, legal correspondence, statutory filings, company registration documents, and key agreements both physical and digital, filed systematically and retrievable within minutes.
Track document expiry dates and renewal requirements company registrations, trade licences, ISO certificates, insurance policies, bank guarantee expiry dates, and power of attorney documents. Alert the MD and COO 60 days before any expiry.
Manage all incoming and outgoing couriers, legal notices, regulatory correspondence, and stamped documents
logging every item with the date received, sender, and action taken.
Maintain confidential files board minutes, MD's personal documents, key contracts, and banking
correspondence in a secure, access-controlled system.
5. Liaison & Coordination
Act as the first point of contact for all visitors, callers, and correspondents seeking the MD screening professionally, gathering context, and routing appropriately. Every person who contacts the MD through this role should feel they have been treated with courtesy and professionalism.
Coordinate internally with the COO, Head-BD, Project Managers, Finance, and HR on action items, information requests, and approvals flowing to and from the MD ensuring nothing sits in transit and every request has a response timeline.
Liaise with external parties bank relationship managers, legal retainers, CAs, government departments, client representatives, and courier services on behalf of the MD, with complete professionalism and discretion.
Coordinate MD's participation in industry events, CII/CIDC meetings, chamber of commerce events, and networking forums registration, logistics, preparation materials, and follow-up actions.
6. Office Administration for the MD's Office
Manage procurement of stationery, printing, and office supplies for the MD's office maintaining stock, placing orders, and ensuring nothing runs out.
Process MD's expense claims, travel reimbursements, and vendor invoices coordinating with Finance for timely processing and maintaining records for audit purposes.
Arrange visa applications, passport renewals, and travel documentation for MD's international travel coordinating with the relevant embassy or travel agency well in advance.
Manage petty cash for the MD's office maintaining a cash register, obtaining receipts, and submitting for replenishment on schedule.
7. Confidentiality & Discretion
Handle all information relating to the MD's office, ICON's business strategy, client relationships, financial position, and personnel matters with absolute confidentiality at all times, including outside working hours.
Exercise professional judgement in what is communicated, to whom, and when. The PA/PS will regularly have access to commercially sensitive, legally privileged, and personally private information discretion is not a policy, it is a character requirement for this role.
Sign and adhere to ICON's Non-Disclosure Agreement on joining. Any breach of confidentiality is grounds for immediate termination.

9.Confidentiality - Zero confidentiality breaches absolute standard, not a KPI range

48 years of experience as a Personal Assistant, Executive Secretary, or Executive Assistant supporting a senior

Personal Attributes Non-Negotiable

Discretion is a character requirement, not a skill.

Proactive over reactive the PA/PS anticipates what the MD will need before being asked. 'Waiting for
instructions' is not the standard.
Calm under pressure the MD's schedule will change at short notice, priorities will shift, and crises will arise. The
PA/PS maintains composure and finds solutions, not reasons why something cannot be done.
Impeccable personal presentation as the first point of contact for clients, bankers, and government visitors at

jobDescription:
The Role

We are hiring a Tech Architect / Lead Developer (.NET) - a hands-on technical leader who will accelerate the build-out of the next generation of our online banking platform for US Banks and credit unions on ASP.NET Core and C#. You will spend a significant portion of your time writing production code and owning architecture, while also mentoring engineers and setting the technical bar.

You will partner day-to-day with Finance Group technology leaders on product and delivery, the Embrace Technology group on shared architecture, cloud and DevOps standards and Venture Labs / the Embrace AI Group to bring emerging capabilities into the platform.

At its core this is a forward-deployed engineering (FDE) practice with an AI-first, new-product mandate. You will embed with financial institutions and internal product partners, turn ambiguous problems into shipped product and lead a small team of highly empowered, highly skilled engineers who take ideas from conceptualization to launch in weeks - not quarters. You will go full-stack from modern UX/UI through public REST APIs down to a .NET control plane and treat large language models and agentic AI services as first-class building blocks of the platform rather than bolt-ons.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and hands-on build the new ASP.NET Core / C# online banking platform - system design, service boundaries, data modeling and API contracts.
  • Design and implement critical features and platform components; lead code and design reviews, setting the technical bar.
  • Lead and mentor a small agile team - run sprints, unblock engineers, own delivery commitments, coach through 1:1s and pair programming.
  • Partner with Finance Group technology leaders, product, QA and security to translate business and regulatory needs into robust solutions.
  • Collaborate with the Embrace Technology group on shared architecture, cloud and CI/CD standards and with Venture Labs / Embrace AI Group to embed AI capabilities (AI-assisted dev, predictive insights, fraud/risk monitoring) into the platform.
  • Drive engineering best practices - testing, CI/CD and adoption of modern AI dev tools.
  • Operate as a forward-deployed engineer - embed with internal product partners to co-design solutions, then rapidly conceptualize, prototype and launch new products, compressing concept-to-production from quarters to weeks.
  • Lead AI-first, new-product development end-to-end - design and ship LLM- and agent-powered capabilities using services such as Google Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI (and Azure OpenAI) and orchestration frameworks like LangChain, with disciplined evaluation, guardrails and cost / latency management.
  • Build full-stack and real-time - modern, accessible UX/UI, public REST APIs and live experiences via SignalR on .NET Core / C# control plane, with event-driven services through Azure Service Bus / messaging, etc.
  • Own the cloud and delivery foundation - infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, CI/CD on GitHub (Actions) and containerized, repeatable deployments across Azure and/or AWS.
  • Engineer security and compliance in by design - identity and access management (OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO, MFA), secrets management and data protection aligned to PCI DSS, SOC 2 and FFIEC, with auditability from day one.
  • Build and empower the team - recruit, coach and unblock a small squad of progressive FDEs, giving them the autonomy, tooling and technical bar to ship safely and fast.

How We Work - Forward-Deployed AI-First

title: Associate Scientific Business Analyst - Biological Studies (LIMS)
jobDescription:
Associate Scientific Business Analyst Biological Studies (LIMS)What you will do

In this vital role you will be working closely with Amgen Research partners and Technology peers to ensure that the technology/ data needs for drug discovery research are translated into technical requirements for solution implementation. The role leverages scientific domain and business process expertise to detail product requirements as epics and user stories, along with supporting artifacts like business process maps, use cases, and test plans for the software development teams. This enables the delivery team to estimate, plan, and commit to delivery with high confidence and identify test cases and scenarios to ensure the quality and performance of IT Systems.

  • Function as a Scientific Business Systems Analyst within a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) product team
  • Serve as a liaison between global Research Informatics functional areas and global research scientists, prioritizing their needs and expectations
  • Handle a suite of custom internal platforms, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software, and systems integrations
  • Lead the technology ecosystem for in vivo study data management and ensure that the platform meets their requirements for data analysis and data integrity
  • Translate complex scientific and technological needs into clear, actionable requirements for development teams
  • Develop and maintain a product roadmap that clearly outlines the planned features and enhancements, timelines, and breakthroughs
  • Identify and handle risks associated with the systems, including technological risks, scientific validation, and user acceptance
  • Develop documentations, communication plans and training plans for end users
  • Ensure scientific data operations are scoped into building Research-wide Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning capabilities
  • Ensure operational excellence, cybersecurity and compliance.
  • Collaborate with geographically dispersed teams, including those in the US and other international locations.
  • Develop a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. You will join a multi-functional team of scientists and software professionals that enables technology and data capabilities to evaluate drug candidates and assess their abilities to affect the biology of drug targets. This team implements LIMS platforms that enable the capture, analysis, storage, and report of pre-clinical and clinical studies as well as those that manage biological sample banks. You will collaborate with Product Owners and developers to maintain an efficient and consistent process, ensuring quality deliverables from the team. You will implement and manage scientific software platforms across the research informatics ecosystem, and provide technical support, training, and infrastructure management, and ensure it meets the needs of our Amgen Research community.

Basic Qualifications:
  • Bachelors degree and 2 to 6 years of experience in Life Sciences, Computer Science, IT, Computational Chemistry/Cheminformatics, Computational Biology/Bioinformatics or related field
  • Demonstrated expertise in a scientific domain area and related technology needs
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for tackling complex challenges in drug discovery with technology and data
  • Experience with writing user requirements and acceptance criteria in agile project management systems such as JIRA
  • Experience in configuration and administration of LIMS platforms such as STARLIMS, Watson LIMS, LabVantage, etc.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • 1+ years of experience in implementing and supporting LIMS platforms
  • Experience in the implementation of scientific software platforms, Electronic Lab Notebook (ELN), or Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)
  • Experience handling GxP data and system validation, and knowledge of regulatory requirements affecting laboratory data (e.g., FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GLP, GCP)
  • Knowledge of bioanalytical workflows and/or biospecimen management
  • Experience in AI and machine learning for drug discovery research and preclinical development
  • Experience with cloud (e.g. AWS) and on-premise infrastructure
  • In-depth knowledge of Agile processes and principles for coordinated solutions and teams via SAFe
  • Knowledge of business analysis best practices, DevOps, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery methodology
Professional Certifications:
  • SAFe for Teams certification (preferred)
Soft Skills:
  • Able to work under minimal supervision
  • Excellent analytical and gap/fit assessment skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work effectively with global, virtual teams
  • High degree of initiative and self-motivation
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully
  • Team-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals
  • Strong presentation and public speaking skills

title: Prompt Engineer
jobDescription:
Profile :

We are hiring a world-class Prompt Engineer, someone with extreme clarity of thought, deep reasoning skills, and hands-on mastery of modern LLM behavior. It is for someone who understands prompting as a science : evaluation, ablation, latency tuning, hallucination control, guardrails and AGI-aligned orchestration.

Requirements :

- Exceptional reasoning, logic structuring and analytical thinking.

- Ability to design deterministic, controlled, and testable prompts for production behaviour.

- Deep understanding of temperature, top-p, top-k, seed, max-tokens, repetition penalty, and their effects on model behaviour.

- Strong mastery of LLM guardrails, prompt-injection defense, role separation, Meta Logic, and system level prompt design.

- Solid understanding of modern LLMs and NLP systems (GPT, Claude, LLaMA, Qwen, Mistral, etc.).

- Knowledge of low-latency model families, quantization (GGUF, INT4/8), and inference trade-offs.

- Clear understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector DBs including when not to use them.

- Ability to run evaluation pipelines (accuracy, F1, hallucination rate, consistency, JSON validity).

- Highly detail-oriented, structured thinker, fast learner.

- Strong communication, able to explain reasoning clearly and concisely.

- Comfortable building measurable experiments instead of intuition-based prompting.

Responsibilities :

- Design high-accuracy prompts for reasoning, extraction, classification, and multi-step workflows.

- Build robust system + user prompt architectures with strict constraints and safety layers.

- Run temperature, seed, sampling, and ordering ablations to achieve deterministic and stable performance.

- Optimize prompts for latency, consistency, cost, and token efficiency.

- Reduce hallucinations using verification loops, guardrails, retrieval control, and role conditioning.

- Architect governing instructions for multi-agent systems and AGI-aligned assistants.

- Build hierarchical prompt layers (system -meta-controller - task-level - tools).

- Select models based on latency, throughput, context window, and domain-specific performance.

- Collaborate with AI engineers on quantization, distillation, caching, and runtime optimizations.

- Maintain versioned prompt libraries with clear documentation, reproducibility, and experiment tracking.

- Work closely with ML, product, and engineering teams to deliver production-grade, scalable prompt flows.

- Write clear technical documents : architecture diagrams, ablation summaries, evaluation reports, and runbooks.

jobDescription:
Transformation Delivery Lead Senior Manager

Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale technology transformation programs for our most strategic clients. You will lead the end-to-end transformation execution, ensuring programs deliver committed business outcomes, financial targets, operational improvements, and stakeholder expectations across Technology Modernization, AI Enterprise Transformation, M&A and Enterprise Agility pillars

Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Transformation Delivery
Level: Senior Manager

Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad

Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture

Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernization, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programs Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping portfolio level leads, directors and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture

If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organizations, and ensuring transformation investments generates lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organizations.

The Practice A Brief Sketch

Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernizing delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.

We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organizations through complex transformation journeys from for translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:

Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership: Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to portfolio priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability: Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernization, and cloud-native migration programs, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity. AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership: Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Revenue Management and Financial Governance: Manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions.

Integration and Dependency Management: Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes. Value Realization and Benefits Framework: Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at portfolio level Global Delivery Leadership: Act as a trusted partner to senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. Executive Stakeholder Leadership: Shape Portfolio level narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings

Role Summary

As Delivery Lead Senior Manager, you will own end-to-end delivery of one or more large, complex transformation programmes with budgets typically ranging from $5M to $30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at Portfolio level, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end programme delivery, ensuring outcomes are on time, on budget, and aligned to contractual SLAs and KPIs.
  • Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CI/CD practices and modern ways of working within client organizations.
  • Lead portfolio-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.
  • Manage relationships at Portfolio and director level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.
  • Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.
  • Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.
  • Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.
  • Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs
  • Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.
  • Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.
  • Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.

What We''re Looking For

  • 12 17 years total experience; 4 6 years in senior programme delivery within a large professional services or consulting firm, including hands-on management of budgets in the $5M $30M range.
  • Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes.
  • Demonstrated track record of Portfolio-level stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management.

  • Experience leading organisational change and embedding operational performance improvements at scale.
  • Track record of account growth, deal-shaping, and business development alongside delivery execution.
  • Strong executive presence: communicates with clarity and gravitas; builds trust with senior audiences rapidly.
  • Must have experience of working across at least one of the following areas; Technology Modernisation, Complex Delivery, Drive Transformation, Revenue Management.

Set yourself apart:

  • Mastery of managing complex deliveries coordinating with more than one supplier with multiple dependencies and work plans
  • Experience delivering cloud-native transformation programs leveraging Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), microservices architectures, API-led integration, or SaaS platforms
  • Experience of delivering transformation at scale within a highly regulated or complex industry sector
  • Cloud/Industry and Programme Management certifications and credentials
  • Demonstrate a strong Technical and Emotional Quotient


What s in it for you

  • An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
  • Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
  • Ability to embed responsible business into everything from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
  • Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities.
  • Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization

title: QA Engineering Manager AI Systems
jobDescription:
QA Engineering Manager AI Systems

Healthcare AI • Playwright Automation • LLM Evaluation • Clinical Safety Validation

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're building the next generation of AI Quality Engineering for healthcare.

This is a capability-building role, not a maintenance role. Rather than maintaining an existing QA organization, you'll define, build, and lead a Quality Engineering function for AI-powered healthcare products from the ground up — establishing the standards, processes, automation, and AI validation practices that will support our platforms as they scale over the next several years.

This is a player–coach role. You are expected to provide technical leadership while remaining hands-on with automation, AI validation, and quality engineering activities when needed. We are open to candidates currently titled QA Manager, QA Architect, or Senior QA Engineer — what matters is the ability to build and lead this function.

THE MISSION

We are not looking for someone to manage a test backlog. We are looking for someone to build and own an AI Quality Engineering capability that will grow with the organization over the next 2–3 years.

Traditional software QA remains essential. But our long-term differentiator is AI quality — and this role will own it end to end.

CORE OWNERSHIP

  • End-to-end software quality across web applications and integrated platform releases
  • AI evaluation and validation — relevancy, faithfulness, contextual accuracy, hallucination detection, bias
  • Clinical reasoning and safety validation for AI-generated treatment suggestions and clinical decision support
  • Hallucination and guardrail testing for AI-driven clinical workflows
  • AI regression testing as models, prompts, and workflows evolve
  • Automation engineering using Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript with full CI/CD integration
  • Release readiness governance — QA release readiness assessments, risk registers, and sign-off processes
  • Design and evolution of scalable AI evaluation frameworks and quality processes
  • Quality KPIs, engineering dashboards, defect leakage trends, automation maturity, and executive reporting
  • AI quality governance, evaluation standards, and engineering best practices

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Organizational leadership

  • Build and scale the AI Quality Engineering function — define team structure, career paths, and engineering standards
  • Hire, mentor, and develop QA engineers; lead capacity planning and resource allocation
  • Establish engineering hiring standards, interview frameworks, and onboarding processes for the QA organization
  • Drive consistent quality standards and governance across internal teams, client teams, and external delivery partners
  • Represent the organization during client discussions, executive reviews, cross-vendor initiatives, technical escalations, and release governance meetings
  • Provide independent quality recommendations and risk assessments to internal leadership and clients, even under demanding delivery timelines

Strategic responsibilities

  • Define and execute a multi-year AI Quality Engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, engineering maturity, and business growth
  • Recommend tooling, frameworks, quality standards, and engineering practices to continuously improve AI Quality Engineering
  • Partner with Engineering and Product leadership on quality strategy
  • Evaluate and introduce emerging AI testing methodologies and tools
  • Drive continuous innovation in AI validation practices
  • Introduce modern quality engineering practices across the organization

AI and clinical quality engineering

  • Design and implement AI evaluation frameworks using DeepEval, RAGAS, LangSmith, Promptfoo, or equivalent
  • Validate GenAI/LLM-based clinical features including treatment guardrails, medication recommendations, and clinical task automation
  • Develop AI regression test suites that detect quality degradation as models, prompts, and data evolve
  • Define clinical safety testing protocols in collaboration with clinical SMEs and product stakeholders
  • Build evaluation pipelines that scale across AI model updates and workflow changes

Automation and engineering

  • Lead automation initiatives using Playwright and JavaScript/TypeScript for UI, API, and end-to-end testing
  • Establish and maintain CI/CD-integrated automation pipelines supporting continuous quality validation
  • Develop automation strategies supporting platform-specific and cross-platform testing
  • Define and track automation coverage metrics aligned to release risk

Quality strategy and governance

  • Define QA strategies, test plans, and quality standards across multiple concurrent product streams
  • Manage defect lifecycle, root cause analysis, risk assessment, and QA release readiness assessments
  • Validate and assess application performance, reliability, security, usability, and compliance requirements through appropriate quality engineering activities
  • Track and report QA metrics, automation coverage, defect leakage trends, AI evaluation maturity, and operational efficiency
  • Drive continuous improvement across testing processes, tools, and delivery practices

SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 12 MONTHS

  • Establish AI Quality Engineering standards across the organization
  • Increase automation coverage and reduce escaped defects
  • Implement AI evaluation pipelines for clinical features
  • Improve release predictability through governance and readiness processes
  • Build and mentor a high-performing QA team
  • Establish AI quality scorecards and executive dashboards adopted across engineering leadership
  • Improve customer confidence in product quality through predictable releases and transparent quality governance
  • Become the trusted quality advisor for clients and engineering leadership

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 8–12+ years of experience in Software Testing / Quality Engineering with demonstrated leadership experience
  • Proven track record of building, scaling, or transforming a Quality Engineering function
  • Strong hands-on experience building automation frameworks using Playwright (preferred) and JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Practical, hands-on understanding of LLMs, GenAI workflows, prompt validation, and AI evaluation concepts
  • Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks such as DeepEval, RAGAS, LangSmith, or Promptfoo
  • Experience testing AI-powered applications in Healthcare AI, HealthTech, MedTech, Life Sciences, or other regulated industries strongly preferred
  • Excellent client-facing communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive-level reporting
  • Ability to communicate effectively with engineering teams, product leadership, executive stakeholders, and clients
  • Experience coordinating quality across internal teams, client teams, and third-party vendors
  • Experience leading geographically distributed engineering teams
  • Ability to design quality processes from the ground up in fast-paced, high-growth environments
  • Experience in Agile/Scrum methodologies

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with clinical safety testing, HIPAA compliance contexts, or healthcare AI validation
  • Exposure to cloud platforms — AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Knowledge of performance testing and security testing practices
  • Experience building AI evaluation pipelines integrated into CI/CD workflows
  • Prior experience in a consulting, technology services, or multi-client delivery environment

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Builder mindset — you want to architect and own a function, not just manage a backlog
  • AI quality depth — you understand why hallucination in a dosage recommendation is categorically different from a UI bug
  • Technical-commercial balance — you can lead a team, represent the organization in demanding client and executive discussions, and still write a Playwright test when needed
  • Healthcare awareness — you appreciate the stakes of clinical AI and bring appropriate rigor to validation
  • Delivery focus — you operate in a fast-moving environment without sacrificing quality standards

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

This role is more than a QA leadership position.

You will help define how AI-powered healthcare systems are validated, governed, and trusted. The practices you establish will influence product quality, clinical safety, and engineering excellence as our organization scales. If you enjoy building functions, solving complex technical challenges, and shaping the future of AI Quality Engineering in healthcare, we'd like to hear from you.

This role operates in a multi-platform, multi-vendor healthcare AI environment. Candidates with experience coordinating quality across distributed and cross-functional delivery teams are particularly encouraged to apply.

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to join our AI team at the intersection of evaluation science, post-training, and foundation model development. You will own our end-to-end eval and benchmarking infrastructure the critical feedback loop that drives every major model improvement while contributing hands-on to post-training pipelines for industry-specific vertical foundation models.
This role is ideal for someone who has worked directly inside an LLM lab and understands what rigorous evaluation looks like at scale: designing the taxonomy of skills being measured, identifying failure modes, engineering synthetic data to close capability gaps, and translating eval signals into actionable training decisions.
WHAT YOULL DO Evaluation & Benchmarking
  • Design and own task-level evaluation frameworks for LLM agents and base models, covering multi-step reasoning, tool/API use, instruction following, and domain knowledge grounded in real user failure modes rather than off-the-shelf benchmark suites.
  • Build comparative benchmarking pipelines to assess leading frontier models (GPT-4o, Gemini, Claude, Llama, Mistral, etc.) against each other and against internal models, with structured analysis of where each model family fails, regresses, or excels across subjects, topics, and task types.
  • Produce capability gap reports that quantify performance deltas across dimensions such as subject-matter accuracy, reasoning depth, factual consistency, and refusal behaviour.
  • Track model version regressions across provider releases to maintain a living competitive intelligence benchmark.
  • Develop domain-specific benchmarks tailored to vertical use-cases (e.g., STEM tutoring, legal, finance, healthcare) including problem taxonomy design, rubric definition, and inter-annotator agreement pipelines.
  • Define and drive synthetic data generation strategies to systematically address model shortcomings in specific subjects, topics, and skill areas:
  • Identify low-performance clusters from eval results and translate them into targeted data generation prompts and pipelines.
  • Design LLM-assisted pipelines for generating high-quality, diverse, and verifiable synthetic training and evaluation data at scale.
  • Validate synthetic data quality through auto-eval, human review, and downstream model performance lift experiments.
  • Build automated regression suites integrated into CI/CD workflows to detect capability degradation across fine-tuning runs and model updates.
  • Partner with product, curriculum, and research teams to translate eval insights into prioritized post-training and data flywheel decisions.
Post-Training & Fine-Tuning
  • Lead or directly contribute to SFT, RLHF, RLAIF, and DPO training runs on industry-specific vertical foundation models from dataset design through training execution and eval-gated release.
  • Curate and engineer high-quality instruction-tuning and preference datasets for domain adaptation, with hands-on experience distinguishing signal from noise in annotation pipelines.
  • Define data quality criteria, rejection sampling strategies, and deduplication pipelines for SFT corpora.
  • Design preference pair construction methodologies and reward model training setups grounded in domain-specific quality rubrics.
  • Implement and experiment with alignment techniques including reward modelling, process reward models (PRMs), and constitutional/RLAIF approaches.
  • Run ablation studies and controlled experiments to attribute model behaviour changes to specific data or training interventions not just report final numbers.

Infrastructure & Tooling
  • Build scalable eval pipelines that run automatically on every training checkpoint and integrate into CI/CD for continuous model quality tracking.
  • Maintain model cards, eval leaderboards, and internal dashboards providing visibility across experiments for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ensure reproducibility through rigorous experiment tracking (W&B, MLflow, or equivalent), versioned datasets, and documented training configs.
WHO YOU ARE Required

  • SFT, RLHF, RLAIF, DPO, PPO from dataset construction through training and eval-gated release.
  • Experience with reward modeling, preference data curation, and quality control for alignment pipelines.
  • Demonstrated experience designing LLM evaluation frameworks beyond standard benchmarks including task-level evals for agentic or multi-step workflows.
  • Hands-on experience building synthetic data generation pipelines to address specific model capability gaps:
  • Designing targeted generation prompts based on eval failure analysis.

Preferred
